title: Hyliion’s KARNO Power Module Named to TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026
summary: TIME recognizes Hyliion’s breakthrough KARNO Power Module for its potential to transform how electricity is generated. AUSTIN, Texas-- Hyliion Holdings
body_markdown:
*TIME recognizes Hyliion’s breakthrough KARNO Power Module for its potential to transform how electricity is generated* .


AUSTIN, Texas– Hyliion Holdings Corp. (NYSE American: HYLN), a developer of modular power plant technology, today announced that its KARNO™ Power Module has been named to **TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026** , an annual list recognizing groundbreaking innovations shaping the future.


As global electricity demand accelerates, driven in large part by the rapid growth of AI, Hyliion is reimagining how power is generated. The KARNO Power Module is designed to deliver highly efficient, cost-effective electricity generation in a compact, scalable modular system that produces power directly where it is needed. The technology is designed for critical applications, including data centers and military operations. Hyliion’s defense programs include a contract to power the U.S. Navy’s USX-1 Defiant autonomous vessel, alongside nearly $50 million in new U.S. military programs expected to be awarded in 2026.


Unlike conventional generators that rely on internal combustion engines or rotating turbines, the KARNO technology utilizes a proprietary linear heat generator architecture enabled by advanced additive manufacturing. The technology is designed to deliver efficient, fuel-flexible, low-emission power generation, scalable from hundreds of kilowatts to multi-megawatt installations.


“Being recognized by TIME as one of the Best Inventions of 2026 is an incredible honor and a testament to our team,” said Thomas Healy, Founder and CEO of Hyliion. “We set out to fundamentally rethink how electricity is generated, aiming to bring power plant-level performance directly to where it’s needed. After years of engineering and development, seeing our KARNO Power Module recognized among the world’s most innovative technologies is a tremendous milestone, and we believe this is just the beginning.”


To compile this year’s list, TIME solicited nominations from TIME editors and correspondents around the world, as well as through an online application process, paying special attention to growing fields such as health care and AI. TIME then evaluated each contender on key factors, including originality, efficacy, ambition, and impact.

**About Hyliion**


Hyliion is creating innovative solutions that enable clean, flexible and affordable electricity production. The Company’s primary focus is to provide modular power plant technology that can operate on various fuel sources to future-proof against an ever-changing energy economy. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, and with research and development in Cincinnati, Ohio, Hyliion is initially targeting data center, military, and commercial and industrial applications with a locally deployable KARNO Power Module that can offer prime power as well as energy arbitrage opportunities. Beyond stationary power, Hyliion will address mobile applications such as vehicles and marine vessels. The Company aims to offer innovative yet practical solutions that contribute positively to the environment in the energy economy. For further information, please visit[www.hyliion.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.hyliion.com%2F&esheet=54622424&newsitemid=20261015782014&lan=en-US&anchor=www.hyliion.com.&index=2&md5=38ae935d395b5412cecc2087c0716edd)
